issues.description: 12 sim.state.* setup assignments (lines 40-50) lack rationale comments, unlike other files that received them. These are clearly setup inputs (not assertions), but the feature description says 'Document rationale for tests that must access internals.' Minor inconsistency.

Reuses `harness.inner.decoder` for decoded status frame verification in 4 places (lines 150, 167, 201, 493), while most other tests create fresh `FrameDecoder::new()` instances. This works correctly because FrameDecoder resets state on new frame start bytes, and generate_status_frame() produces complete frames. Not a bug, but an inconsistency with the prevailing pattern.
